prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style educational asset graphic. A side-by-side lineup of three distinct ceratopsian eggs arranged neatly on a flat, neutral light-grey studio floor. visual_logic: Presents three realistic, unpigmented shell mineralization and taphonomic rock variations within the ceratopsian clade, framed perfectly for a 1:1 mobile interface layout using a red apple for scale.
style_notes: SQUARE_HERO_CARD, STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3. Ensure the aspect ratio is exactly 1:1. Only one horizontal scale bar at the very bottom edge. All items must stay within the central power-zone grid without touching the frame limits.
